topic: The Transformational View of Derivatives: From Slopes to Sensitivities

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Geometric Interpretation
lecture_lines: Derivatives represent the tangent line slope.
Imagine a climber on a steep curve.
The slope reflects local steepness changes.
animations: Draw tangent line at point on curve #FF0000.
Highlight slope calculation triangle near point #00FF00.
Animate secant line approaching tangent line #FFFFFF.

sections.title: The Transformational Shift: Derivative as a Function
lecture_lines: View derivatives as a transformation machine.
It maps curve points to slope values.
Red curve input, blue derivative output.
Each x-value has a unique slope.
The derivative is now a function.
animations: Slide derivative function f'(x) in below #00FF00.
Show correspondence between points x and f'(x) #FFFFFF.
Trace f'(x) as x moves along f(x) #FFFF00.
Highlight zero points where f'(x) hits axis #00FFFF.

sections.title: The Sensitivity Operator
lecture_lines: Derivatives act as sensitivity operators.
They measure output changes from input wiggles.
Robotic arms show input sensitivity.
Sensitivity scales with the derivative value.
Input change dictates output precision.
animations: Show input variable x with delta change #FF0000.
Show output f(x) with resulting change #00FF00.
Display ratio delta f / delta x #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Dynamic Application: The Speedometer Analogy
lecture_lines: Position is a static state.
Velocity is the derivative of position.
Cheetah motion transforms into speed.
Speedometer tracks constant change.
From location to motion dynamics.
animations: Display speedometer needle at initial position #FF0000.
Animate needle moving as position increases #00FF00.

sections.title: Summary & Visualization Check
lecture_lines: Derivatives dynamically transform input information.
Move from snapshots to ongoing processes.
Input shapes become output sensitivity heatmaps.
animations: Display summary of key derivative concepts #FF0000.
Animate all visual elements fading in unison #00FF00.
